{{Quote|I'm Major Triam, Thirty-fifth Recon. You can stand at ease.|Major Triam|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Thirty-fifth Recon''' was a unit in the [[Republic Army]] led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Triam]] that was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
